integrity: The statement, proof, and reproducibility script are included in this package; no external artifact is required for execution.
scientific_limitations: Only independent uniform coupon types and the first main-album completion stopping time are treated.
Uniform functional approximation is for compact index windows around log N of width order sqrt(log N).
No second-order Gaussian residual law, nonuniform-array extension, or exhaustive literature-priority certification is claimed.
Finite numerical and exact arithmetic tests do not establish the infinite functional limit; the analytic proof is essential.
title: A rank-one Gumbel fluctuation law for logarithmically indexed coupon siblings
